theorems.name: Submission.allard52_amcl_interval_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p R Λ t : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → 0 < R → 0 < Λ → 0 < t → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ t → ContinuousAt (a k) τ ∧ |a k τ| ≤ 2 * ((p - n) / (4 * p)) * Λ / R * (τ / R) ^ (-((n : ℝ) / p))) → (∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ t → Tendsto (fun k => a k τ) atTop (𝓝 (g τ))) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ τ in (0)..t, a k τ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ τ in (0)..t, g τ)) ∧ |∫ τ in (0)..t, g τ| ≤ Λ / 2 * (t / R) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ) / p)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
